title: Exchange IIS Worker Dropping Webshells
description: This query checks for the IIS worker process dropping files that resemble web shells and other artifacts seen in known attacks. Reference: https://msrc-blog.microsoft.com/2021/03/02/multiple-security-updates-released-for-exchange-server
query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' and ('Parent Process Name' = 'w3wp.exe') and ('Command Line' like '*MSExchange*') and (('Target Filename' like '*\\\\\\\\wwwroot\\\\\\\\*' or 'Target Filename' like '*HttpProxy\\\\\\\\owa\\\\\\\\*' or 'Target Filename' like '*\\\\\\\\Temporary ASP.NET Files\\\\\\\\*')) and (not(('Target Filename' like '*\\\\\\\\tmp\\\\\\\\*' or 'Target Filename' like '*\\\\\\\\dl3\\\\\\\\*'))) and (not ('Target Filename' like '*.log')) and (not ('Target Filename' like '*.json')) and (not ('Target Filename' like '*.ini')) and (not ('Target Filename' like '*.vb')) and (not ('Target Filename' like '*.tmp')) and (not ('Target Filename' like '*.xml')) and (not ('Target Filename' like '*.js'))

ask_ai_prompts: Summarize the Microsoft Sentinel converted detection results and identify the highest-risk pivots.
